title: Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard: Modernization of FMVSS No. 108 to Accommodate Automated Driving Systems-Equipped Vehicles
pass_4_primary_concern: The proposed visibility table reverses the preamble’s headlamp-state intensity values.
pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: Roadway lighting affects crash prevention, pedestrian visibility and signaling to surrounding traffic.
pass_5_concise_why: The modernization retains essential lighting functions, but its preamble and proposed visibility table reverse the intensity values for headlamps on and off. That narrow, repairable mismatch needs one consistent compliance requirement before finalization.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: An unresolved table mismatch could produce different certification and enforcement interpretations of marker-lamp visibility.
